outcomes.RF01: Roots, prefixes and suffixes now have separate identities. -ka, -esh, -vel and other affixes no longer inherit the free root with the same letters.
outcomes.RF02: Buttons retain affix spelling. Word-specific senses are explained inline instead of opening a different root.
outcomes.RF03: Explicit prefix and suffix records participate in a separate affix inventory.
outcomes.RF04: A Built from section links recorded component words to their existing entries. Those base entries have reciprocal family links.
outcomes.RF05: Unregistered or word-specific components retain their explanations on the word. No new productive root or headword was created.
outcomes.RF06: An exact root match no longer suppresses recorded components. A historical note about Lunwek is not parsed as a derivation of Lun.
outcomes.RF07: Family lists are no longer capped in the data or exports. The page offers View all with a count and grouped connections.
outcomes.RF08: The app-facing KA explanation follows ED-0038. Standalone ka and possessive -ka remain distinct.
outcomes.RF09: Explicit reviewed family links resolve directly, including Aenvor and the reviewed -eth examples.
outcomes.RF10: Combined source headings are no longer family identities. Existing individual records and approved word-specific components are used; old source comparisons remain preserved.
outcomes.RF11: Only explicit word evidence establishes links. Formula-only source notes are retained without automatically creating words or relationships; see evidence_disposition.json for each formula.
